scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:tools && npm run test:shell && npm run test:checks
scripts.test:tools: tools/hoist-skill/test && tools/sync/test && node tools/linter-setup/test && node tools/dependency-watch/test
scripts.test:shell: for f in scripts/test-*.sh; do [ "$f" = scripts/test-read-once.sh ] || bash "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:checks: node scripts/check-resolvable.ts --strict && node scripts/update-skills-doc.ts --check && node scripts/check-agents-detail.ts && node scripts/check-handoff.ts && node scripts/check-guidelines.ts && node scripts/render-explorer-pages.ts --check
scripts.test:integration: RUN_INTEGRATION=1 tools/hoist-skill/test-integration && RUN_INTEGRATION=1 tools/sync/test-integration && RUN_INTEGRATION=1 tools/linter-setup/test-integration
